meta.name: aeon
meta.description: This skill should be used for time series machine learning tasks including classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, and similarity search. Use when working with temporal data, sequential patterns, or time-indexed observations requiring specialized algorithms beyond standard ML approaches. Particularly suited for univariate and multivariate time series analysis with scikit-learn compatible APIs.

copy.tagline: 完成时间序列数据的分类、预测与异常识别
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有按时间顺序记录的数据,想预测走向或发现问题
copy.tagline_en: Build forecasting, classification and anomaly detection models on time-stamped data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have time-stamped data and want to forecast trends or spot unusual patterns.

howto.what: Claude 会写 Python 代码调用 aeon 库,用与 scikit-learn 一致的接口完成时间序列的分类、回归、聚类、预测、异常检测、分割和相似性搜索,也能加载内置数据集与基准结果。
howto.when: 当你处理按时间排序或序列型数据(分类、预测、异常检测等),需要标准机器学习之外的时序算法时,它会接管。
